```yaml
name: ghalint

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/**/*.yaml'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install ghalint
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint/releases/download/v1.5.1/ghalint_1.5.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          tar xzf ghalint_1.5.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          mv ghalint /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Run ghalint
        run: ghalint --path .github/workflows --exclude .github/workflows/ghalint.yml
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          persist-credentials: false
```
